Name: Gunther's Home
Author: Riazaia
Description:
Uses TMX Loader to add a lil home for Gunther. 

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]*This mod was made for the SDV Discord Spirit's Eve event and as such is sPoOky (kinda) so Beware*[/b][/size][/color]

[b][size=4]How to Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[*][size=4]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]Pytk[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMXLoader[/url][/size]
[*][size=4]Download, unzip and put the resulting folder inside Mods folder. It should look like this: [/size][...]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[TMX] Gunther House
[*][size=4]Enjoy![/size]
[/list]
